stories.title: The Glassmaker of Oakhaven
stories.question: Can a village artisan save the seasonal frost festival without using forbidden magic?
stories.answer: Yes, by melting down old window panes to forge glowing lanterns that capture warmth from the autumn sun.

story_beats.headline: The Chilly Discovery
story_beats.speech: Master Weaver, the winter wind arrives three weeks early, and our harvest lanterns will not stay lit in this gale.
story_beats.label: Frost Approaches

story_beats.headline: The Artisan's Choice
story_beats.speech: We must break down the stained glass from the grand workshop to gather trapped solar heat before night completely falls.
story_beats.label: Breaking Tradition

story_beats.headline: The Fiery Hearth
story_beats.speech: Feed the kiln with dry pine and spin the molten crystal quickly so it seals the captured warmth inside each facet.
story_beats.label: Forging Light

story_beats.headline: The Warm Celebration
story_beats.speech: Look how the children dance safely under the amber glow while the gentle festival light keeps the bitter winter frost entirely at bay.
story_beats.label: Festival Saved

stories.title: The Glassmaker's Last Breath
stories.question: Can a dying artisan capture the essence of a fading storm inside a fragile sphere?
stories.answer: Yes, by sealing the thunder within cooled crystal, she preserves the tempest's roar for generations.

story_beats.headline: The approaching gale
story_beats.speech: We must hurry before the purple gale shatters the workshop windows and steals our final evening of warmth.
story_beats.label: Storm Gathering

story_beats.headline: The molten core
story_beats.speech: Careful with the blowpipe now, because spinning the molten silica too fast will ruin the delicate pressure inside.
story_beats.label: Spinning Glass

story_beats.headline: Trapping the thunder
story_beats.speech: Hold the funnel steady while I guide the stray lightning bolt directly into the heart of the cooling orb.
story_beats.label: Capturing Lightning

story_beats.headline: A glowing legacy
story_beats.speech: Look at how the captured storm illuminates the entire dark room, proving our dangerous night's work was truly worth every scare.
story_beats.label: Persistent Glow
